messages:
Maya (AE): Quick update - HealthNimbus POC is ready to convert. Legal returned DPA redlines and procurement has PO requirements. Need quick alignment on signature flow, liability cap exception, and whether BYOK/KMS is needed for the POC.

Ravi (SE): Heads up, their security team asked for SAML SSO + KMS. We only support customer-managed KMS for Private deployments; confirm whether POC must use BYOK or OK with managed keys.

Maya (AE): They said managed keys are ok for POC, but will ask to include KMS integration line item for later. For now priority is DPA and order form.

Priya (Legal): On DPA: main asks are (a) right to audit clause tighter, (b) 30-day data return/export window, (c) reduce liability cap to 2x fees. We can accept audit notice and 30-day export with stronger security attestation, but 2x liability needs Exec/legal lead approval. I'll prepare a suggested counter.

Tess (Procurement): For PO, we need: legal entity name, tax ID, remit address, PO number, and two authorized signers (primary + alternate). Also they prefer DocuSign and want customer to apply signature first. Who is collecting signers?

Maya (AE): I'll collect signers. Proposed signers: Allison Park (CFO) + Raul Vega (Head of Procurement). PO number TBD after legal sign-off.

Omar (Finance): Net30 preferred. Finance needs billing contact, remittance email, and GL code if they require PO-matching. Also flagging cash-application SLA for AR.

Maya (AE): Draft order form snippet I'm inserting into thread: 

```
Order Form
Customer: HealthNimbus, Inc.
Billing contact: billing@healthnimbus.com
Remit address: 123 Health Ave, Suite 400, Boston, MA 02115
Term: 12 months
Commit: $72,000 / month
Billing terms: Net30
One-time onboarding credit: $5,000 applied to invoice #1
Signers: Allison Park (CFO), Raul Vega (Procurement)
```

Priya (Legal): Add e-sign clause: "Electronic signatures (DocuSign or equivalent) have same effect as originals." Also add that countersign will occur upon final review; if liability cap exception required, loop in emma_r for sign-off.

Tess (Procurement): Also confirm sequencing: customer signs Order Form + DPA -> Redwood countersigns -> customer issues PO referencing signed order form. They asked for countersign before PO issuance; will that block payment timing?

Omar (Finance): Countersign before PO is fine as long as PO references order form and invoice. We need the billing email on OF. If they delay PO issuance, first invoice could be delayed; put "PO to follow" language if required.

Ravi (SE): On KMS note: add statement in order form that BYOK available for Private deployments and integration timelines will be separate SOW. Keeps POC scope small.

Maya (AE): Good idea. I'll include: "BYOK/KMS integration available for Private deployment per separate statement of work."

Priya (Legal): I'll upload the redlined DPA and a short cover note: accept audit notice + 30-day export; request escalation for liability cap change.

ops-privacy-bot: SOC2 report attached (link: https://redwood.internal/reports/soc2)

Tess (Procurement): Please confirm if we can add a 2-week onboarding milestone and map it to the $5k credit. They want milestones for internal approvals.

Ravi (SE): Confirmed we can map $5k onboarding credit to milestone completion within first 30 days.

Maya (AE): Final checklist before I send to customer: (1) Updated order form with billing + credit + BYOK note, (2) Redlined DPA with comment on liability cap for exec, (3) DocuSign flow: customer signs then Redwood countersigns, (4) Billing contacts: billing@healthnimbus.com, finance-billing@redwood.com cc'd. Anything else?

Priya (Legal): Add ops-privacy@redwood.com and legal: priya@redwood.com on the send. If exec signoff needed, cc emma_r.

Omar (Finance): Add finance-billing@redwood.com to CC for PO routing. Also request anticipated PO number once available.

Maya (AE): Thanks team. I'll send OF + DPA redline to HealthNimbus legal and post response here. :thumbsup:
